tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List covered US cities and counties (ids, names, permit counts, newest permit date), permit categories and prices. Free.

tools.name: permit_stats
tools.description: Count building permits issued in the last N days (1-90) by category, for one area or all. Free.

tools.name: permit_trends
tools.description: Daily permit counts and the busiest cities and zip codes for one category over the last N days. Free.

tools.name: count_permits
tools.description: How many permits match a search (area, category, city, zip, dates, minimum value) before paying for the records. Free.

tools.name: search_permits
tools.description: Newly issued building permits with address, permit type, description, contractor, job value and issue date, filtered by area, category, city, zip, dates and minimum value. Up to 100 per call. Costs $0.05 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.

tools.name: permit_history_for_address
tools.description: Every known building permit at a street address in any covered area. Costs $0.10 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.

tools.name: weekly_permit_report
tools.description: All building permits issued in the last 7 days for one area, with counts by category. Costs $0.50 in USDC (x402; Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum); no charge when nothing matches.
